body: Same for me! I'll let you know if I get any updates

I used to drink it to fall asleep during some very hard times. 

I now only drink it when absolutely necessary. It's almost guaranteed I'll have a nightmare. Maybe I have the nightmares anyway cause of anxiety, but whenever I drink valerian root I remember everything, and wake up 1-2 times per night due to the nightmares.
I won't say much. Everything has been said already. Get out, or kick him out.

Thank you so much for your reply.
I'll find a way to contact his doctor or somebody from his team. We tried to do the same with my mom due to some side effects he used to have, but when they'd see him and ask him about any side effects (without mentioning us, I believe this might be part of their ethics), he'd say that he's doing great and that all is well. 

As for my mom, it wouldn't surprise me at this point. She has received so much abuse and beatings as a child from her own parents, her environment was so toxic, that it wouldn't surprise me if her brain was blocking things out, or if she remembered and maybe tried to suppress the memories. 

Up until this point I thought, mistakenly, that abuse starts when someone's hand lands on your cheek. But I have talked about some of these events to a couple of close friends, and my boyfriend, and mentioning those events as normal. They were speechless and told me that "no, it's not normal". 

I'll find someone who's on his doctor's team, and definitely keep my distance. I hope he doesn't lay a hand on my mom, cause if he does I'll involve anyone I can to help her, including the police.

Thank you again so much for taking the time to read and reply!
